confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Lagos, Algarve (Portugal), a small coastal resort town, not the Nigerian city. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season and town-level hotel and hostel pricing is hard to pin down, so they are bounded estimates. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. FX provenance: the 2026-10-16 observation (0.6947 USD per AUD) was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to RBA-published data, with 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 as a cross-check. I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so verify the figure against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Algarve coastal resort towns with similar July tourism demand, such as Portimao, Albufeira and Armacao de Pera, adjusted for Lagos being a smaller town. Drink prices are set relative to beer using typical Portuguese tourist-area ratios.
